requirements.text: Reset clears both local pointers and deasserts full while asserting empty.
An accepted write stores one data word and advances the write pointer exactly once.
A write request while full must not modify memory or advance the write pointer.
An accepted read returns the oldest unread word and advances the read pointer exactly once.
A read request while empty must not advance the read pointer.
Pointers crossing clock domains use Gray coding and two-stage synchronization.
The design preserves ordering across independent write and read clocks.
Full and empty flags are generated in their local clock domains.
